title: Count once on ingest, read tiny rows forever after
caption: The stream job folds clicks into (ad, minute) counters; the dashboard never touches raw events.

steps.text: Every click is appended to a partitioned stream, keyed by ad_id so one ad's events land on one partition.
The stream job keeps a counter per (ad_id, minute) in keyed state and flushes finished buckets as +n upserts, not one write per click.
The raw events are archived too: you'll need them to backfill a new dimension or to fix a bad count.
The dashboard's "last hour for ad1" is 60 point lookups on (ad1, minute), a few kilobytes.
